This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
v2: a PLACEHOLDER until the canary sweep picks it (59/60/61, the median read). ci/make_canary.py builds a canary by changing ONLY the value below; the canary check refuses any other difference.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds: 16.667 ns == 60 MHz (info.yaml clock_hz; gate_clock_consistency holds the two to 1 ps).

I/O delay: 30 % of the period (5.0 ns in, 5.0 ns out). SOURCES, both sky130 and NOT IHP: the TT clock spec (tinytapeout.com/specs/clock/) allows up to 10 ns clock/reset insertion delay; the TT GPIO spec (tinytapeout.com/specs/gpio/) measured a worst round trip of 20 ns, under 2 ns pin-to-pin, on TT3.5, one die, about 22 C. A 20 ns round trip exceeds the 16.7 ns period, so NO same-cycle external round trip is allowed: outputs are flop Q (F2) and no input returns in the cycle it leaves. Not load-bearing at the 8x4 canary: worst I/O setup +11.45 ns, every I/O path above +10.9 ns at slow.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.

HOLD REPAIR AFTER GLOBAL ROUTE (Wilson, hold bar +0.05 ns at every corner): without it the margin above is inert (the post-GRT resizer step does not run) and hold is repaired only after CTS, on placement parasitics; routing then left 3 short tx_bitp paths at -0.020 ns (fast corner) on the reset-network halt.
v2 timing closure at 60 MHz (Wilson 10-25, T1/T2): 2.5 ns of setup slack asked of the resizer, timing-driven placement, post-GRT design repair.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

THE LATCH STORE (Wilson 10-31 / 11-03): the 512-byte store in IHP stock latches (sg13cmos5l_dlhq_1), one latch_posedge clock gate per row (sg13cmos5l_lgcp_1), the write data through 8 hold delays (sg13cmos5l_dlygate4sd3_1). PE_IHP_CELLS makes pe_store use src/pe_cells_ihp.v's bindings instead of its generic cells; gate_store_latch simulates the bound version against the PDK's own cell models. RSZ_DONT_TOUCH_RX keeps the resizer from removing the 8 hold delays (they are the hold margin by design).
